name: Necropolis; Dahrtag
description: Necropolis, originally named Dahrtag, was a planet in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Located on the Giju Run, it was a tombworld of that served as a mass burial place for beings from all over the Galactic Core. It was also the home of boneworms and cryptberries.
